newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia bourse, fuelled by banks, at new records.
newsitem.headline: Estonia bourse, fuelled by banks, at new records.

text.p: Hansapank and Hoiupank maintained their rise on Monday as local investors continued to fuel the banking sector and helped the Estonian stock market set more records.
"We don't know where this money is coming from, but most of the interest seems to be local," one dealer said.
Trade on the main list was 79.3 million kroons and the Talse index rose a huge 5.49 percent to close at a record 383.49.
Hansapank turned over 23.8 million kroons and ended at a new high of 221.88 kroons, up 19.12 kroons.

"We are not seeing too much foreign interest buying directly into the market at present, and investors seem to be selling their industrial stocks and looking for faster returns in the bigger banks," another trader said.
In Helsinki, Hansapank was also traded up to 81 markka after opening at 75.1 markka.
Hoiupank led trade by volume to close 5.90 kroons higher at 230.90 kroons after turning over 25.2 million kroons.
"Hoiupank has still to release its revised profit forecast and this will happen on Wednesday, so some interest could be coming from speculation on the new figures," another dealer said.
Forekspank followed the leaders to be five kroons higher with a close at 240 kroons after 17.8 million kroons changed hands.
On the free market, 14.1 million kroons changed hands with Norma the most active stock.
Norma saw trade of 9.1 million kroons to close at 90.95 kroons, up 0.95 kroons.
